repos.name: janestreet/agent_skills

bullets: Built by Jane Street, focusing on high-reliability primitives for agentic workflows.
Provides a structured framework for agents to interact with external systems and data.

repos.name: shanselman/gputaskman
repos.description: An htop for what's inside your NVIDIA GPU on Windows: process memory, engine activity, and LLM weights/KV-cache introspection
repos.one_liner: A real-time monitoring tool for NVIDIA GPUs on Windows, specifically optimized for LLM and AI workloads.
bullets: Provides granular visibility into process memory, engine activity, and GPU utilization.
Includes specialized introspection for LLM weights and KV-cache memory usage.
Essential infrastructure for developers optimizing inference performance and debugging memory bottlenecks.
Acts as an 'htop' for AI-specific hardware tasks, bridging the gap between system monitoring and model performance.
repos.img_alt: Live GPU overview with an LLM's weights, KV cache, and compute buffer breakdown
repos.img2_alt: Compositor selected, showing local memory and the explanation of shared-surface accounting

repos.name: ranxianglei/billion-context
repos.description: A context-compression plugin for month-long single sessions (billions of tokens) ,small context windows (a 100K context is enough) and token savings (5x fewer tokens) .上下文压缩插件，月级长会话会话， 兼顾小窗口(100k上下文足矣)省token(省5倍token) . billion-context is all you need
repos.one_liner: A context-compression plugin designed to enable month-long AI sessions with massive token efficiency.
bullets: Reduces token consumption by 5x while maintaining performance in long-running sessions.
Allows for 'billion-token' context handling using standard 100k context windows.
Critical infrastructure for long-term memory in AI agents and persistent conversational assistants.
Implements advanced compression techniques to lower latency and costs in LLM-based applications.

repos.name: DIYgod/pinky
repos.description: Let AI agents use your phone, with you in the loop.
repos.one_liner: An automation framework that allows AI agents to interact with mobile devices while keeping the human in the loop.
bullets: Enables agentic control over mobile interfaces, bridging the gap between LLMs and physical device interaction.
Designed with a 'human-in-the-loop' architecture to ensure safety and oversight in automated tasks.
Useful for testing, data scraping, and automating complex workflows on mobile platforms.
Leverages Go for high-performance orchestration of agentic actions.

Core infrastructure for AI research teams building embodied agents and physical world models.
Highly optimized C++ backend with Python bindings for seamless integration into ML pipelines.
